    Watch the San Diego Padres vs. Colorado Rockies on April 11, 2026, at 8:40 p.m. ET (5:40 p.m. PT) at Petco Park via Padres.TV or Rockies.TV. The game is also available on FuboTV, or locally on CBS 8 in San Diego. 
    TV & Streaming Options 
    • Streaming: Padres.TV and Rockies.TV (via MLB.TV) offer in-market streaming. FuboTV is another major option to stream the game.
    • Local TV (San Diego): CBS 8 (KFMB) is broadcasting the game on Saturday, April 11.
    • Cable/Satellite: Check channel listings for Padres.TV (often available on DirecTV 694-3, AT&T U-Verse 781/1781, Cox 83, Spectrum 305/443). 
    Radio 
    • English: 97.3 The Fan.
    • Spanish: XEMO-AM La Poderosa 860.
